title: Translation and Literary Design of Matthew 3:1-6
caption: <bp-cite>Matthew 3:1-6</bp-cite>. Translation and Literary Design by Tim Mackie for BibleProject Classroom: Rise of the Messiah (2024)
usx:
<usx version="2.6">
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="3:1" /> Now, in those days <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="black">Ioannes</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="cyan">the immerser</char> arrived, 
        </group>
        <group>
          announcing in <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="tan">the wilderness</char> of <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">Ioudaia</char>, 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="B" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="2" /> saying, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          “<char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">Change direction</char>! 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          Because <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan">the kingdom of the skies</char> has come near!” 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A'" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="3" /> For <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="cyan">this is what was spoken through Esaias the prophet</char>, saying, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          “A voice calling in <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="tan">the wilderness</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          prepare the way of <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">the Lord</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          make straight his paths.” 
        </group>
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group indent="1" type="secondary">
      <group>
        <verse number="4" /> Now, <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="black">Ioannes</char> himself had his clothing from the hair of camels, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and an animal-skin belt was around his waist, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and his food was grasshoppers and wild honey. 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group>
        <verse number="5" /> Then, there came out to him Hierosoluma, 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        and all <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">Ioudaia</char>
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        and all the surrounding region of <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="violet">the Iordanes</char>, 
      </group>
      <group>
        <verse number="6" /> and they were <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="cyan">immersed</char> in <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="violet">the Iordanes river</char> by him, 
      </group>
      <group>
        while <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">confessing their moral failures</char>. 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
</usx>
